title: Air-permeable hydrogels through viscoelastic phase separation of aerogels.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC full text (167k chars) read for data availability and supplementary captions; no accessions in text, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI GEO/SRA links, no Zenodo/Dryad record for the DOI. Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint timed out at 75 s (not retried, per policy).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Data availability says all data are in the paper and/or Supplementary Information, which is a PDF of methods, 35 figures and 8 tables plus 8 videos. Sample counts are per-experiment replicates of a handful of hydrogel formulations; no deposited tabular dataset exists.

a1_downloadable.note: No data repository; data is only in figures and a Supplementary Information PDF (not retrieved, endpoint timed out). Nothing machine-readable is deposited.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Labels such as oxygen permeability (in barrer, a gas-permeability unit) would have to be digitised from plots for a few formulations; no label column exists.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (formulation, aerogel loading, processing time) are described in methods text only, not as a table.

a4_units_stated.note: Paper text states units (barrer, vol% water); not checked in any file.

a5_enough_rows.note: Materials study with a few formulations and small replicate counts; far below ~400 rows. Exact count not seen in files.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No downloadable data to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Permeability and water content are physical measurements, but too few to model.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper reports a materials-fabrication method with a handful of measured formulations and no deposited dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use hydrogel recipe and processing settings to predict oxygen permeability and water content of the finished gel.
plain_idea.train_on: Formulation and processing parameters per hydrogel sample; number of samples unknown but a few formulations with replicates, digitised from figures.
plain_idea.predict: Oxygen permeability (barrer) measured by gas-permeation tests in the lab.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Materials engineers designing breathable wearable or tissue-engineering hydrogels could screen recipes faster, but this paper alone cannot support it.

ml_idea: Formulation-to-permeability regression for hydrogels; not feasible from this paper's data.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement: data only in paper/SI, no repository.

verdict_reason: Materials-science fabrication paper (largely outside biology) with no deposited data: everything is in figures and an SI PDF, a few formulations only, so A1, A2, A3 and A5 fail.
